Test your own phone in 20 seconds

LiDAR helps, but isn’t required

Every tool works with the camera alone. On LiDAR devices, surfaces are found faster, dim rooms work better, and 3D room scan becomes available.

Questions people ask

Measuring with a phone: straight answers

What is the best app to measure a room with an iPhone?

For a single distance, any AR tape measure will do, including Apple’s built-in Measure app. For a whole room you need more: floor area, perimeter, ceiling height, a floor plan you can share, and totals across several rooms.

That is what Metre’s Home survey is built for. Tap the corners of each room and it adds up m² or ft² and m³, draws a bird’s-eye floor plan and exports it as PDF, or as DXF for CAD. On an iPhone or iPad with LiDAR, Metre can also create a 3D room scan with a floor plan automatically.

Can my iPhone measure without LiDAR?

Yes. Every iPhone that runs iOS 17 supports ARKit, which combines the camera with the motion sensors to find floors, walls and tables and to measure between points. LiDAR, found on Pro iPhones since the iPhone 12 Pro and on iPad Pro models since 2020, adds a depth sensor: surfaces are found faster, dim rooms work better and results are tighter.

In Metre every tool works without LiDAR except the automatic 3D room scan, because Apple’s RoomPlan requires a LiDAR scanner.

How accurate is an iPhone tape measure?

In good light, on a surface with some texture, with the point at the centre of the screen and 1–3 m away, AR measurements are often within 1–2 cm; LiDAR usually does better. Errors grow in dim light, on glass, mirrors and black fabric, at very short or very long distances, and near the edges of the frame.

Metre shows a precision ring that turns green when it is confident, marks every saved result with how precise it is, and can test your own phone against an A4 sheet or a bank card. For cutting, ordering glass or anything you cannot undo, confirm with a physical tape.

How do I measure a window for curtains?

Measure the window’s width (the frame, or the recess if the curtains hang inside it) and its height. Then:

  • Rod length = window width + an overhang on each side, commonly 15 cm (6 in).
  • Fix the rod about 10–15 cm (4–6 in) above the window.
  • Curtain width = rod length × fullness: about 2× for gathered curtains, 1.5× for a lighter look.
  • Drop = from the rod to the sill, below the sill, or to the floor minus about 1 cm so the hem does not drag.

Metre’s Windows & curtains tool measures the window in AR and does this arithmetic for you.

How can I find my ring size with my phone?

The most reliable way is to measure a ring that already fits. Lay it on the screen and match a circle to its inside edge; the inside diameter converts to a size, for example 17.3 mm is about US 7, UK N½, EU 54.5.

Because screens differ, calibrate first. Metre’s Ring sizer uses a one-time calibration with a standard bank card (85.6 mm wide) and shows US, UK, EU and JP sizes. Measure at room temperature; if you are between two sizes, choose the larger one for wide bands.

How do I measure someone’s height with an iPhone?

Have the person stand straight with their feet visible, step back two or three metres and keep the whole body in the frame. Metre’s Height tool detects the body and the floor and measures automatically. The same tool measures doors, shelves and ceilings from two points. For children, the Height tracker keeps a dated history on your device.

How do I calculate the floor area of a room or apartment?

For a rectangular room, multiply length by width. For an L-shaped room, split it into rectangles and add them up. For an apartment, add up the rooms, and decide whether balconies count; they are usually left out of the net living area.

Metre’s Home survey lets you tap the corners of each room, choose the room type, keep net and total area apart, and export a floor plan as PDF.

Will this sofa fit, and will it go through the door?

Measure the space (width, depth, and the height under windows or shelves), then the door opening and any tight turns in the hallway. As a rule of thumb, a piece of furniture passes a door if its smallest dimension, often the depth, is less than the door’s clear width.

Metre’s Will it fit? places a true-size virtual box in your room from the dimensions in the shop listing, and Door check measures the opening for you.

Does Metre upload my photos or need an account?

No. Camera frames and photos are processed on your device with Apple’s ARKit, Vision and RoomPlan frameworks and are never uploaded. There is no account, no sign-in, no analytics, no ads and no tracking. Your measurements are stored in the app on your device.

Is Metre free?

Metre is free to download. Length, height, the level, the on-screen ruler, all 50 how-to demos and saving measurements are free with no time limit.

Metre Pro unlocks everything else, including Smart scan, area, box and volume, the whole-home survey, 3D room scan, the calculators, the body and size tools, and PDF, CSV, DXF and USDZ export. It is available as a weekly or monthly subscription with a 3-day free trial, or as a one-time lifetime purchase.
